Who We Are

We are a fourth-generation farming family with a deep love for working the land together. Our purpose is to create cheese that is both wholesome and exceptional in flavor, while treating our animals and environment with respect. Sharing our passion through our products brings us joy, and we hope you experience that same joy with every taste.

About Us
What We Do

As a farmstead creamery, every cheese we make begins here on the farm—where our sheep are born, raised, and nurtured on lush pastures. Each small batch reflects our dedication to purity, flavor, quality, as well as the wellbeing of our flock.

Our Practices
Sustainability at Hidden Springs Creamery

At Hidden Springs, sustainability isn’t just a choice, it’s part of our identity. In January 2025, we took another big step forward by installing a 49.5 kW solar array on our farm. These solar panels capture clean, renewable energy from the sun, reducing our dependence on fossil fuels and lessening our overall environmental footprint.

We estimate that this system will offset 36% of our total energy use in its first year alone, powering everything from our creamery operations to daily farm activities. Beyond the numbers, this investment reflects our ongoing commitment to preserving the land and air that sustain us. Every watt of solar energy generated helps protect our local environment, improve air quality, and support a healthier, more resilient future for our community.

Farming in Harmony with Nature

Our philosophy has always been simple: farming should give back more than it takes. That belief shapes every decision we make, from how we manage our pastures to how we care for our flock.

Rather than working the land with aggressive tillage, we nurture it. No-till practices help us preserve vital soil structure, prevent erosion, and encourage rich organic matter to build naturally over time. This living soil supports thriving pastures filled with diverse grasses and legumes, exactly what our ewes need to stay healthy and produce exceptional milk.

During the warm Wisconsin summers, our sheep graze freely across our hillside pastures, where no herbicides or pesticides are ever used. This ensures a pure, natural environment for them and keeps our land teeming with beneficial insects, native plants, and vibrant microbial life beneath the surface.

In everything we do, from soil to solar, we’re guided by a deep respect for the natural systems that make our farm possible. At Hidden Springs, sustainability isn’t an end goal, it’s a continuous, living promise to care for our animals, our land, and our planet for generations to come.

Shipping policy
We ship perishable cheese products using temperature-controlled packaging to help ensure they arrive in excellent condition.
Orders are processed every Monday and shipments go out every Tuesday to ensure adequate weekday shipping for products to reach their destination, unless otherwise noted. Once shipped, delivery timelines vary by destination and selected shipping method. Tracking information will be provided once your order leaves our facility.
Please ensure that someone is available to receive your package upon delivery. We are not responsible for packages left unattended after confirmed delivery.
